# Overview

This page share elements, function or behavior that you'll be able to find into the app.
  
## Accessibility

There is several way to access to page function, you can access it by navigating through menu, target it via URL. You can also limit access by passing elements in the URL or more globally by settings custom attributes into user profile.

### Url access

Direct link can be set in manner to go directly to the target resource by following this example structure: `https://mesx.app.corp/downtime-ui/machine_01`. In fact the structure is the `https://server/function/resource_id`.

### Restriction profile

Thanks to custom attributes management for the user, by adding "resource" parameter and passing a specific resource_id, this will limit the user scope to this machine only.

## Smartsearch

SmartSearch is the way users interact with digital platforms by making search processes more intuitive, accurate, and user-focused. Meanwhile user is typing is search we display relevant result which contains similar caracters than the one typed. For some application result can be retrieved based on differents scope, technical and/or description.

## Header

This section that appears at the top of the page, typically containing important introductory or navigational elements. The header is often consistent across a functions, providing a familiar structure for users as they browse different page.

### Menu

Contain links to the main sections of the website. It include dropdown menus for subcategories, permitting to reach the different function of the MES. You can also use [smartsearch](https://dev.azure.com/faurecia-cloud/MES_X.0/_wiki/wikis/MES_X.0_User_Documentation?wikiVersion=GBmain&_a=edit&pagePath=/Common%20elements&pageId=6461&anchor=smartsearch) to find what you are searching for.

### Logo

Forvia logo can be resume to F, it first serve the brand identity. As most of the screen are displayed in full screen user lost the "previous"/"Step back" originally available on webbrowser. That's why clicking on the Forvia logo permits to be back to the previous page.

### Title function

Unique titles are set on each function, it sets clear expectations for what users will find on the page, it helps to quickly identify the most relevant page for their needs, making it noticeable.

### Hierarchy selection

The plant hierarchy is a vertical structure set from Plant and cascading down to workstation, navigating though it will permit you to select where you want to instance the function. It must be most of the time at a specific level. Hierarchy visibility can be limited by [restriction profile](https://dev.azure.com/faurecia-cloud/MES_X.0/_wiki/wikis/MES_X.0_User_Documentation?wikiVersion=GBmain&_a=edit&pagePath=/Common%20elements&pageId=6461&anchor=restriction-profile), user could see and navigate only to element which are permitted.

#### Collapse ellapse

Hierarchy elements are group by level which can handle different elements, openning a new branch below it. The order is the following one Plant/UAP/Prod line/Workcenter/Resource/Workstation. You can ellapse and collapse the hierarchy in a manner to deepdive on a specifc hierarchy branch.

#### Mouseover

Hierarchy elements are display by description, however in system hierarchy are written by technical name, by passing your mouse over the description a label will pop displaying the technical name of the element.

#### Search

On top of hierarchy you search for an elements by typing description or technical name. Thanks to [smartsearch](https://dev.azure.com/faurecia-cloud/MES_X.0/_wiki/wikis/MES_X.0_User_Documentation?wikiVersion=GBmain&_a=edit&pagePath=/Common%20elements&pageId=6461&anchor=smartsearch) logic relevant result will be adjusted while you are typing.

### Datetime

Screen on shopfloor are displayed in full screen this is hiding native datetime from the Operative System (OS), that's why we display it on the header, letting people to have a reliable time to refer while working.

### User

On top right similar to other webpage you'll find the user account currently connected, clicking on it you can choose to profile details or to log out.

# Overview

The objective of the Leveling Board is to display the Withdrawal Kanbans position in a timeline based on different grouping criteria to help Logistic Operators anticipating issues with truck delivery.

By default each kanban card is visualized based on the original picking date, however there is an option to see the rescheduled kanban cards based on last promise date given by production.

![image.png](./.attachments/image-462773b0-a1c5-44a3-b0a6-3983cbbecf8c.png)

**WK Display:**

The WK are displayed in squared cells and hold the following information (PIK status / Flow (TPA / Pool) / Alert status / Sebango):

![image.png](./.attachments/image-c87abe11-2712-49d1-afe5-cef1777b9846.png)

## Header / Action Panel

### Header

![image.png](./.attachments/image-d3ddfbb7-be71-42dc-b1bd-2d8e3cb678d5.png)

The header is a common section throughout the MES X.0 screens and has the following elements:

- Menu
- Log
- Title of the screen
- User logged in
- Current datetime

### Action Panel

![image.png](./.attachments/image-dc5f1c9c-95f1-48bb-8fdb-a96ddb4193ec.png)

#### **1. Toggles to data displayed:**

- Aggregated View - this view groups WKs by their picking times, making it easier to visualize high-volume WKs. There is a set up to define the time slot for aggregating WKs in the Aggregated View. Configuration needs to be done under Site Maintenance.

- Alert Info - this toggle unchecked will hide teh Alert info in the kanban card
- PIK Status - this toggle unchecked will hide the status of the related PIK of the WK
- Flow  - this toggle will hide the flow type information in the kanban cards.

#### **2. Original Schedule:**

This toggle is checked by default and kanban cards are shown on their original picking date.
Once this is unchecked the kanban card is shown when is the new promise date for picking given by production.

#### **3. Elements for Zoom in/out or navigate:**

![image.png](./.attachments/image-b7155224-2ada-4826-b706-c138f3b8b57f.png)

Ability to zoom in  / out
Ability to move in the Leveling Time frame in the past or future
Ability to switch back to original timeframe
Ability to make the Leveling Board full screen.

#### **4. Set Leveling Board Time Frame:**

We have the following option to set the leveling board time using this widget:

- Now
- Last 24 hours
- Next 24 hours
- Last 7 days
- Next 7 days
- Custom Range - ability to select specific start date - end date

![image.png](./.attachments/image-2663050d-deea-489e-b593-2cdbe0ccc3dc.png)

#### **5. Timeframe slider and display button:**

This widget gives the ability to easily change the timeframe of the Leveling Board. By default is 7 hours in the past and 7 hours in the future.
Display button will allow you to fix the settings made regarding the time frame.
![image.png](./.attachments/image-f608fb86-d482-4245-a348-9fcea9c1d90c.png)

#### **6. Filters:**

![image.png](./.attachments/image-6193f86f-1e87-4097-898d-286a858ffe64.png)

The following filters are available to use. Ability to select multiple in case of dropdowns.
Once selected click on SEARCH button to filter data on the screen
Ability to save filters against user profile by clicking on the SAVE button
Ability to reset filters by clicking on the reset button.

- Material
- Outbound Delivery
- Work center
- Picking Order
- Destination Type
- Source Type
- Custom Status
- Picking Status
- Customer
- TPA
- Start Preparation
- Truck Departure

#### **7. Line Ordering:**

![image.png](./.attachments/image-15b73efb-4e4d-4937-818d-bcff7ebc7e2a.png)

By clicking on the line reordering widget the user is able to change the order of the lines displayed in the leveling board.

## Main Screen

### **Grouping Criteria**

![image.png](./.attachments/image-f5b3b0b7-d985-445d-9262-e150ca678c54.png)

The operator is able to select 2 different grouping criterias for WKs to be displayed on each line.

The user is able to group WKs using the following different properties :​

- Source : (Work Center Id = concatenation of Work Center code and Work Center description) OR POOL​
- Source type : SHOP OR Pool​
- Truck : (TPA Id = concatenation of Customer Description and Truck departure timestamp in local time) OR Pool​
- TPA Name : TPA Name associated to truck or Not assigned or POOL​
- Destination type : TPA or POOL​
- Sebango​
- Customer : concatenation of customer code and customer description

Please Note : ​

- One or two grouping properties can be selected. ​  
- When the Truck grouping property is selected, we can display the preparation time indicators and the truck departure with an icon​

### **Levelling Board - Gantt View**

In the main screen of the Leveling Board, each row is displayed based on grouping criterias selected. In the timeline the current time is shown with red line and Kanban cards which are matching the grouping criteria are shown based on their Picking Time.

For Each Kanban Card we have the following information displayed.

- Alert Status: - This shows the individual alert status for the withdrawal Kanban.
- Related PIK status: can be empty , PR = related PIK is in production, CL = related PIK is closed, HU is ready to pick.
- Flow Type: - WK are categorized in 3 main flow types based on their source and destination location.
    ![image.png](./.attachments/image-a6b2455e-e223-4b0c-9bd2-821823315120.png)
- Sebango : this represents the abbreviated   material code of the WK.

**Alert Status : We can have the following possible level of colour coding  and alert status.**

![image.png](./.attachments/image-c51cc835-5937-4088-befd-527cf2dba8ed.png)

For each withdrawal Kanban we also display the status of the related PIK, so the logistic operator is clear about the current production status of the WK.

![image.png](./.attachments/image-c03579ee-0e6d-41c5-8421-b5e1f4b81b12.png)

**Original Schedule:**

In case a WK is rescheduled and new promise date has been given by production the system is showing with a different way the WK kanban and Logistic Operator can switch with a toggle in the Action Panel to show the new position of the Kanban card.

![image.png](./.attachments/image-5f0e8884-ca80-49a0-be30-8503f61af127.png)

**Colour Coding on the timeline:**

- Dark blue - area where all WKs displayed are considered late.
- Light blue - area where all WKs displayed are in the past but not considered late since they are in the acceptance timeline (this acceptance time line is configurable)

The tolerance value is a configuration at site maintenance screen by default is set at 60 min.

![image.png](./.attachments/image-39131e5e-5356-4ed7-9eef-fa7e12bdab19.png)

In case we select the grouping criteria Truck - we are displaying the for the related TPA the following colour codes for each line:

- Yellow - this area represents the difference between start preparation and end preparation date for the TPA.
- Orange - this area represents the difference between current hour and end preparation date for the TPA

In case the date now is not in between the begin preparation and end preparation we neglect the orange and display yellow only
in case the orange and yellow are overlapped, we keep the orange.

- Red - this area represents red zone which after truck departure date of the TPA.

![image.png](./.attachments/image-6b0ce588-e34b-44c7-8b82-15ac9fa47c77.png)

## Required Configuration

Go to Common - Site Maintenance -  - Shipment

![image.png](./.attachments/image-f390ba22-fdf6-4a63-8fc0-38e11683b8bb.png)

![image.png](./.attachments/image-de1e9f97-9c75-425b-afe1-769b325be37c.png)

We have 2 main parameters to set:

- Late time acceptance in past (minutes):

This parameter control the tolerance time for WKs which are having the picking date in the past.
In the Leveling Board this period of time is displayed with Light blue on the timeline.

- Aggregation time for Leveling Board (minutes):

This parameter is used for Aggregated View and controls the time period for which the WKs will be aggregated and shown in a single card. By default parameter is set to 1 hour which means the system will display only 1 card for WKs which are having the picking date in one hour time frame.

# TPA Picking screen

## Overview

The objective of the Picking Screen is to allow logistic operators to visualize in an iPad or in a PC screen the TPA picking status of withdrawal kanbans sent by the scheduling tool to MES.

The screen displays by default all the WKs showing on the top the ones which have the Picking Date in the past as it was planned in the scheduling tool.
The logistic operator using this screen can also alert production operators if the WK's picking date is in the past and the container is not available to pick by asking a new picking time from production.
The TPA monitoring screen allows also to filter and see only the relevant data by picking operator. Filters can be saved against user profile.
For example each picking operator can save some specific work center from where they are picking containers.
The view can also customized to show only relevant data in terms of picking time (for ex: 7 hours in the past / 7 hours in the future)

![image.png](./.attachments/image-51d238df-5be4-4905-b5ba-1a1bb3eee41b.png)

## Header / Action panel / Filter

### Header

![image.png](./.attachments/image-d3ddfbb7-be71-42dc-b1bd-2d8e3cb678d5.png)

The header is a common section throughout the MES X.0 screens and has the following elements:

- Menu
- Log
- Title of the screen
- User logged in
- Current datetime

### Action panel

![image.png](./.attachments/image-391ff1b7-ec91-4591-83a1-3df34489cdd1.png)

The action panel allows to perform some actions on the screen and has the following buttons:

- **Open Alert** - the operator is able to select a WK to pick and click on OPEN Alert.
- **Display Filters** - Operator is able to click on Filter to open up and see all the available filters
- **Select Columns and set Preferences** - by clicking on this button operator will be able to see all the available columns in the Picking Screen and select the ones which he wants to display on the screen. The order of the columns orders can be adjusted as well.

- Customer

**Default Time Filter - Picking Time Scale:**

By default, the filter is set to -7 hours / +7 hours relative to the current time.

Custom Time Filter Options

Users can adjust the time window as follows:

- **By Hours:**

- **By Days:**  
    Minimum: 7 days  
    Maximum: 7 days
- **By Weeks:**  
    Minimum: 2 weeks  
    Maximum: 4 weeks
Once the filter is closed, the selected date range is displayed on top of the date selector in blue, providing a clear summary of the applied filter.

## Picking Table Columns

Picking table columns can be customized : display or not display and also the display order of them can be customized.  
The following columns are available

![image.png](./.attachments/image-7188af02-98d9-4812-af6f-66530b916e66.png)

- Alert Column with following possible display

    1. Late WK is considered late but no alert created. Picking time of the WK in the past.

    ![image.png](./.attachments/image-a8f5c4f2-247f-4025-936d-7a81f2fbc865.png)

    1. WK is considered late, alert open, promise is late to come from production (tolerance value is passed see below Required Configuration)

    ![image.png](./.attachments/image-ed26c903-8f87-412d-9444-bc77fa3d01b4.png)

    1. WK is late, new promise time given by production is in the past

       ![image.png](./.attachments/image-56cd331b-299e-4dfd-b0c7-3712726d27d4.png)

**In addition to alert icons each row is colour coded based on Escalation Level of the WK:**

1. **WK  is White:** - WK is not considered late. Picking time + advance picking duration > date/time now
2. **WK is Grey** - WK is considered late no alert is requested. Picking time + advance picking duration < date/time now
3. **WK is Yellow** - Alert open, promise time < End of preparation time
4. **WK is Orange** - Alert open : End of preparation time < promise time < Truck departure time OR End preparation Time < date/time now.
5. **WK is Red** - Alert open, promise time >Truck departure time OR Truck Departure Time < DattTim now

### Required Configuration

1. Go to Common - Site Maintenance - Shipment and configure the following parameters under Picking Screen Section

    - **Tolerance (minutes)** : this parameter is the tolerance value for response time from Production for all the alerted WKs. In case no response is sent from Production within the tolerance value alert will be escalated.
    - **Picking Time Horizon** : this parameter controls picking time horizon and WKs to be displayed in the Picking screen in the future. Default value if not changed is 60 minutes.
    - **Alert Creation** : Manual / Automatic - this parameter controls the alert creation logic.

    - [ ] Manual - Alert is created from the picking screen by selecting a WK and clicking on OPEN Alert button.
    - [ ] Automatic - Alert is created automatically for each WK which is considered late.

    ![image.png](./.attachments/image-2bae6866-4544-4543-86fd-7be60ca3706b.png)

1. Alert Creation Parameters in MII

In case of alert we use the MII alert we rely on configuration in MII to add / configure a new Alert:

We have 4 screens to enable a new type of MII alert:

- **Alert Code Configuration:** - Add Reschedule WK Code

![image.png](./.attachments/image-b7f4f876-f36b-4842-8403-a8c1575d6412.png)

- **Alert Details Configuration** : A new Logistic Alert needs to be configured under **Alert Details Configuration**. Reschedule_WK alert needs to be added by plant or by specific Work Center.
    ![image.png](./.attachments/image-fbed8352-18d0-4d8f-a85d-6d0fffbf61a1.png)
- **Role Phone Contacts** - Admin : In this screen we need to define the different roles we want to send the notificaiton including phone number in case SMS will be triggered.
- **Alert Sending Configuration** - define in this screen the roles and passcodes for each level of alert.
![image.png](./.attachments/image-9b6408ca-884d-45ef-a8df-bb4bccc28eb4.png)

1. Cockpit Configuration - Add new Reschedule WK function

    - Cockpit Configuration : Reschedule WK function needs to be added to the Cockpit to visualize all the alerted WKs.
    - Work Center Configuration : specify Advanced Picking Duration for each work center. This parameter will control if a WK is considered late or not, after Picking Date. If WK picking date + advanced picking duration is > datetime then this WK is not considered late.
    ![image.png](./.attachments/image-44479d45-1860-477d-8bd2-0c5a37467dea.png)

## Alerting workflow

![image.png](./.attachments/image-e4362e75-9983-4502-a775-337d6c43373f.png)

Alert Generation : ​

- We will reuse the DMC alert object in MII which will be linked to WKs having the possibility to define escalation rules in addition to the alert statuses defined in the workflow. ​
- Alerts will be displayed in the Launcher using a new function Reschedule WK
- This new function will be added in the cockpit  which we show the alerted WKs where Production needs to provide new promise date. ​
- Target Notifications based on previous workflow is flexible to set based on user role.​

Alerting after new Promise Date is given by Production:​

​Yellow level:​

- Promise date is given which < end preparation date.
- Yellow alert to be open and but alert with status ACKNOWLEDGED – no reaction needed from production alert will disappear from the cockpit as alerted wk.​
- In addition to that IF my current time pass end preparation it goes to orange automatically, or red if my current time pass truck departure with the required notification​

Orange Level:

- Promise date is given > end preparation time – orange alert to be open and but alert ACKNOWLEDGED – no reaction needed from production alert will disappear from the cockpit as alerted wk. ​
- In addition to that If my current time passes truck departure then of course it will go to red automatically. ​

Red level: ​

- Promise date is is given > Truck departure – Red alert to be open and but alert ACKNOWLEDGED – no reaction needed from production alert will disappear from the cockpit as alerted wk. No rescheduling can be done.​

We send notification in this case as well according to red level. ​
